other.tags: Ambient electronic soundscape. A high-frequency sine wave oscillator generates a steady, unmodulated drone. A resonant low-pass filter sweep moves slowly across a white noise generator, creating a rhythmic, percussive texture resembling a synthesized shaker or hi-hat. A digital delay with high feedback creates a rhythmic pulse at 120 BPM. The piece is centered on a static C5 pitch. A granular synthesis engine processes a metallic sample, resulting in sporadic, high-pitched chirps and digital artifacts that pan randomly across the stereo field. The dynamic level remains constant with no traditional melodic or harmonic progression.
other.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[high-frequency sine wave drone, white noise with resonant filter sweep]

[Main Section]
[digital delay pulse at 120 BPM]
[granular synthesis chirps and metallic artifacts]

[Outro]
[filter sweep narrows, sine drone fades]

bass.tags: Industrial techno with heavy distortion and mechanical textures. A distorted kick drum with a long, saturated sub-tail provides the rhythmic core at 130 BPM in the key of F minor. A high-pass filtered white noise riser sweeps upward over four bars. A metallic, percussive synth sequence plays a repetitive sixteenth-note pattern with a short decay and high resonance. A low-frequency oscillator modulates the cutoff of a gritty sawtooth bassline. Distorted industrial hits and clangs occur on the off-beats. The track features a dense, compressed mix with heavy sidechain compression on all melodic elements triggered by the kick drum. A resonant band-pass filter sweep moves across a background drone.
bass.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[distorted kick drum with sub-tail, metallic percussion hits]
[white noise riser sweep]

[Main Section]
[sixteenth-note resonant synth sequence enters]
[sidechained sawtooth bassline]
[distorted industrial clangs on off-beats]
[resonant band-pass filter sweep on background drone]

drums.tags: Hardcore punk. Distorted electric guitar plays rapid down-stroked power chords in a constant eighth-note rhythm. The bass guitar follows the guitar progression with a thick, overdriven tone. Drums utilize a fast d-beat pattern with a prominent, uncompressed snare and constant eighth-note hi-hat hits. Vocals are shouted with a raspy, aggressive delivery and minimal melodic variation. The recording has a raw, lo-fi aesthetic with high-frequency saturation. 180 BPM. Key of E minor. 4/4 time signature.
drums.prompt:

[fast distorted guitar power chords, d-beat drums, overdriven bass]
